prompt_latex: \text{State the slope of the line through A(3, 5) and B(3, −2), and the slope of the line through C(−4, 6) and D(5, 6). Then write the equation of each line.}

prompt_parts.text: State the slope of the line through A(3, 5) and B(3, −2), and the slope of the line through C(−4, 6) and D(5, 6). Then write the equation of each line.

worked_solution: Line AB: both x-values are 3, so run = 3 − 3 = 0
rise = −2 − 5 = −7, and slope = −7 / 0 is undefined (a vertical line)
Line CD: both y-values are 6, so rise = 6 − 6 = 0
Every point on AB has x = 3, so the equation of AB is: x = 3
Every point on CD has y = 6, so the equation of CD is: y = 6
final_answer: AB: undefined slope, x = 3; CD: slope 0, y = 6
